latestReview.note: SoL 0.1.2 adds independent image_upscaling core operation: direct single-frame PNG/JPEG/WebP to 2x PNG, EXIF orientation, supported ICC to sRGB, resized alpha preserved. Existing published weights and model IDs reused. Runtime 1.8.8 already published and anonymously downloaded with trusted signature verification. 174 related tests and exact signed managed install passed: standard 4K RGBA, custom-prompt RGBA, video/audio regression, cancellation/restart/uninstall. Installer license consent remains enforced. Desktop Host capability discovery, resource planning and ACPF changes still need Desktop release; Mini-App bridge/UI integration is separate.
